name: Mahou Shoujo no Majo Saiban
source:
"There is a girl among you who has become a witch."

On the morning she was supposed to start her first year of high school, Ema woke up inside a dimly lit cage. Imprisoned within a remote island prison mansion for a crime she doesn't remember committing, a confused Ema receives a declaration from a single owl:

"You have been identified as a potential [b]witch[/b] — one who brings harm to this world."
"You will spend the rest of your life here as a prisoner."

The everyday life she took for granted completely collapsed. As Ema gets to know the other girls, all fellow witch candidates, during her imprisonment, the owl eventually gathers all the prisoners and declares:

"A witch trial will now commence."

And so began an utterly cruel game — a process of selecting, one by one from the thirteen girls, the [b]witch[/b]... that is, the one to be executed.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3101040/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“你们之中有一个女孩，已经成为了魔女。”

在她本该开始高中一年级的早上，艾玛在一个灯光昏暗的笼子里醒来。埃玛因自己不记得犯下的罪行而被关押在一座偏远岛屿的监狱宅邸中，困惑的埃玛收到了一只猫头鹰的声明：

“你被认定为潜在的[b]witch[/b]——给这个世界带来伤害的人。”
“你将作为囚犯在这里度过余生。”

她习以为常的日常生活彻底崩溃了。当艾玛在被监禁期间认识了其他女孩，所有女巫候选者时，猫头鹰最终聚集了所有囚犯并宣布：

“女巫审判现在开始。”

于是，一场极其残酷的游戏开始了——从十三名少女中逐一选出[b]女巫[/b]……也就是被处决的过程。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3101040/]Steam[/url]]
